name: @enbox/electrobun-dwn
description: Electrobun app that runs a local Enbox DWN server

scripts.prebuild:dwn: bun run --filter @enbox/common build && bun run --filter @enbox/crypto build && bun run --filter @enbox/dids build && bun run --filter @enbox/dwn-sdk-js build && bun run --filter @enbox/dwn-clients build && bun run --filter @enbox/agent build && bun run --filter @enbox/auth build && bun run --filter @enbox/api build && bun run --filter @enbox/protocols build && bun run --filter @enbox/dwn-sql-store build && bun run --filter @enbox/dwn-server build
scripts.dev:clean: DWN_RESET_ON_START=true bun run prebuild:dwn && DWN_RESET_ON_START=true electrobun dev
scripts.dev:clean:watch: DWN_RESET_ON_START=true bun run prebuild:dwn && DWN_RESET_ON_START=true electrobun dev --watch
